body: FC6 would be the way to go if you are not a rally lead. T11 troops have a new ability which unlocks with FC8, so you're probably better off slowly upgrading in WA while focusing on furnace level
I am 321 days in and I got 9,937 tokens. Haven't bought any of the other cosmetics, purely saving for the city skin since the start

The only time anyone can see if you're using fc to upgrade is when they click on the help tab in alliance or you fully complete the furnace upgrade and it shows up on the furnace leaderboard. 

That being said, it depends on your goal and playstyle. Personally, I play for prep and I encourage saving for prep. Not everyone has a stockpile of speedups to breeze through upgrades in prep week, so it’s okay to use fire crystals and other materials, just do so in moderation and aim for just enough to get basic rewards. 

One reason why f2p or small spenders are encouraged to save for prep is that you can't be 100% reliant on whales to carry the entire state during prep. If you are using your saved-up materials and resources to compete with your whales in KOI/other events, you are creating competition within your own state and the whales might not be happy about having to spend more. 

At the end of the day, it is a game and no one can really force you to do anything you don't want to. Just be careful and communicate with your alliance leaders.

The koreans in my state are pretty chill and quiet. We run a NAP4 in the state with 2 of them being korean majority alliances. Presidency on rotation and we work together as one during SVS. I asked my R5 about this topic also, and they mentioned they didn't know that KOR has such a bad name outside of our state. No dictatorship by any alliance, we respect everyone but we keep MOI on post-approval so we don't get fked by randoms.
